desc: Implement `count_upto(n)` as a digit DP memoized on (pos, started, sumd, prod, tight) with prefix-count reduction `count_upto(r) - count_upto(l-1)`.
Skip leading zeros so they contribute nothing; accept iff `started` and `sumd>0` and `prod % sumd == 0`; an actual zero digit yields prod 0 → beautiful.
Run the code on sample cases (10,20)->2 and (1,15)->10 plus edges (single digits, 10, 100, r=999999999) — validated correct.
